item.title: Assam's Sri Sri Batadrava Than in Nagaon Gets New Life as Batadrava Cultural Project
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam’s Sri Sri Batadrava Than in Nagaon district has been transformed into the Batadrava Cultural Project, with Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Monday, December 15, announcing that the restored spiritual site is ready for inauguration by Union Home Minister Amit Shah. item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court on Monday, December 15, refused to entertain a public interest litigation (PIL) seeking judicial intervention over the widespread cancellation of hundreds of IndiGo flights, directing the petitioner to approach the Delhi High Court with their grievances. item.title: Educational Programme Held at Assam's Saraighat College to Promote Learning Among Govt School Students
item.description: A day-long educational programme for schoolchildren was organised on Sunday, December 14, at Saraighat College in Changsari by Gyan Uttaran in collaboration with the Help to Help Group. The initiative aimed to encourage learning and creativity among students from government schools. Gyan Uttaran is an NGO working towards the educational upliftment of underprivileged children studying in government institutions. item.title: Body of Another Missing ISKCON Devotee Recovered from Brahmaputra in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: The body of another missing ISKCON devotee was recovered from the Brahmaputra River in the morning of Monday, December 15, officials confirmed. The deceased has been identified as Pratap Rai (35), a resident of Biswanath Chariali. The first body was recovered on December 13. item.title: NIA to File Chargesheet In Pahalgam Terror Attack Case On December 15
item.description: GUWAHATI: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) will file a chargesheet on Monday, December 15, in connection with the Pahalgam terror attack of April 22, 2025, officials said. The chargesheet will be presented before a special NIA court in Jammu. item.title: Veteran Assam Journalist & Padma Shri Awardee Prafulla Govinda Baruah Passes Away
item.description: GUWAHATI: Veteran Assam journalist and Padma Shri awardee Prafulla Govinda Baruah passed away on December 14 at around 9:30 PM at a private hospital in Guwahati. He was 92 and had been suffering from age-related ailments. Baruah was the Chairman Emeritus of The Assam Tribune Group and a towering figure in Assam’s journalistic landscape.
